text:
ryan: flying red-eye tonight. looking for: a short book or audiobook (<=6hrs) and a 90-120min movie that wont make me hate humanity. low plot commitment.

nina: audiobook rec: 'We Have Always Lived in the Castle' narrated by Julia Whelan. creepy but compact. perfect for nodding off but staying engaged.

oliver: movie: The Secret Life of Walter Mitty (Ben Stiller). feels travel-y and not too heavy, nice visuals.

ryan: hmm on the fence about comedy vs feel-good. any indie film recs?

tam: try Hunt for the Wilderpeople (Taika Waititi). 100min, very warm, weird bits, big-hearted. great in-flight.

luis: quick music rec if you want background: Sufjan Stevens - Illinois (full album) or Bon Iver - For Emma. gentle and long enough for a leg of the trip.

kara: book rec (short): 'The Sense of an Ending' by Julian Barnes. slim, neat twist, very readable on a plane.

ryan: love Barnes. anyone have a lightweight sci-fi option? not dystopia please.

oliver: try 'All Systems Red' (Martha Wells) novella  it's a fun, short sci-fi read with a sarcastic robot. ~3hrs audiobook.

tam: movie-small gem: 'Paterson' (Jim Jarmusch). mellow, 118min, poetic. not a plot rollercoaster. very soothing.

nina: if you like anime movies and want something visually striking but not heavy: 'The Girl Who Leapt Through Time' (Mamoru Hosoda). uplifting and quick.

luis: also 'Your Name' if you want a more emotional anime but it's still crowd-pleasing.

kara: mini-poll: book or audiobook? I vote audiobook for sleeping. :zzz:

bot-books: informal poll snapshot: audiobook 4  physical book 1  ebook 1 :books:

ryan: audiobook it is. downloading All Systems Red and We Have Always Lived in the Castle for backup. thanks!

nina: pro-tip: bring an eye mask + small travel pillow. airplanes ruin good books otherwise.

oliver: also offline subtitles: if you watch something on a tablet, download subtitles in advance. saved me from loud crying on a full plane once.

ryan: notes added. will report back whether I actually sleep or just keep skipping tracks. :laughing:

tam: safe flight! post a tiny review in here when you land (1-2 lines).

ryan: deal. might include a tiny spoiler-free emoji rating. :)
